claim: evidence_ledger.py subcommand that exports the ledger as PROV-O JSON-LD is prov-export
sub_question: Which evidence_ledger.py subcommand exports the ledger as PROV-O JSON-LD?
evidence: Module docstring lists prov-export; argparse registers subparser name prov-export with help Export the ledger as a PROV-O JSON-LD graph.
quote_or_anchor: The `prov-export` subcommand emits a PROV-O JSON-LD document describing the ledger as a graph of prov:Entity (claims/sources) and prov:Activity
notes: Also argparse: sub.add_parser('prov-export', help='Export the ledger as a PROV-O JSON-LD graph.'); Commands list: prov-export --file evidence.csv [--out prov.jsonld]

claim: The two PROV-O classes that appear in the @graph are prov:Entity and prov:Activity
sub_question: Which two PROV-O classes appear in the @graph?
evidence: prov_export builds claim/source nodes with @type prov:Entity and activity nodes with @type prov:Activity; self-test asserts both types exist in @graph.
quote_or_anchor: The output uses a tiny PROV-O subset: - prov:Entity for each ledger row (the claim) and its source URL - prov:Activity for each distinct prov_activity_id
notes: Code assigns @type prov:Entity on claim_entity and source_entity; @type prov:Activity on activity; doc['@graph'] = graph. Self-test requires both types in types set.
